name: – Michael Gahler – After § 25 – Am 54
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 25a. Reiterates that Ukraine’s accession process must remain strictly merit-based and transparent and that the same accession criteria should be applied equally to all candidate countries; stresses that Ukraine’s accession should not be subject to different standards from those applied to previous enlargements or to the candidate countries from the Western Balkans, and opposes shortcuts or alternative forms of integration that could undermine the EU’s values, decision-making capacity, legislative framework, institutional functioning or the credibility of the enlargement process;
